reorders.reason: S4b (LAW §6, B3): card/scroll.css joins card's own rung, one door per unit: its 18 rules (.card-scroll-host and the .card-header--shrink family, their @supports/@media arms and two @keyframes) now precede the feedback-tone register instead of following the sheet rung. Written from the floor baseline's own rule lines (cascade-floor styles.seq 712-729), the moved set the verifier's longest kept order yields. Also in this entry: S39-03 (B6, the 500-line bound): Timeline.vue renders its marks through TimelineMarks.vue, a child component whose scoped block the build emits before its parent's, so Timeline's own ten rules (.tl, .tl__track, .tl__span, .tl__fill, .tl__cap, .tl__detail and their arms) now follow the marks rules instead of preceding them. The marks rules declare pointer-events, block size, margin, padding, list-style and position on the marks elements; the one Timeline rule that also selects .tl__marks declares grid-area and align-self, so no swapped pair shares a declared property (FD-4 judges each pair)
